_notes: Which custom_model_data value draws which character's face on a rolled character card.
The keys of this object are astrum:character ids; the values are the custom_model_data
integers the roll writes onto the card stack. Adding a character is one line here plus
models/item/card_<id>.json and one entry in character_card.json's overrides.
Order matters in exactly one way: the values must be ASCENDING in character_card.json's overrides
array, because ItemOverrides bakes that list in reverse and matches with a >= threshold.
The portraits these models name (astrum:gui/portrait/<id>) live only in the optional art pack;
with no pack installed a rolled card draws vanilla's purple/black checkerboard, which is the
intended 'install the pack' signal. See docs/balance-derivation.md and task-39-report.md.
